eps.ov: Back in the present, Takemichi is stunned to learn that he has become officer in Toman. Kisaki seizes an opportunity to dupe him, and Takemichi finds himself staring down the barrel of a gun.
Back in the past, Takemichi befriends Hakkai Shiba, and has a violent run-in with Black Dragon.
Takemichi is beaten to a pulp by Taiju Shiba. To save him, Hakkai proposes a bargain to Taiju.
Hakkai decides to join Black Dragon to save Takemichi, but Mitsuya opposes it and confronts Taiju.
Takemichi and Chifuyu make a decision after some conflict about working with Kisaki.
Propelled by each their own motives, the alliance members head to the church on Christmas night.
Takemichi gets back in the fight to protect Yuzuha, who is key to changing the future.
After making a bold declaration, Takemichi keeps rising up from Taiju's beatdowns.
Amidst overwhelming odds, a familiar bike engine heralds Mikey's arrival, but he is acting off.
Takemichi faces Hina, the girl he broke up with just the day before.
Mikey makes an unexpected announcement at Toman's first meeting of the year.
Takemichi returns to the present, but finds the timeline to be the worst one yet.
Takemichi returns to the past and realizes what he must do after meeting Chifuyu.
